subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Reconhecer a pronúncia de verbos regulares no passado (-ed).

components.description_pt: Reconhecer os três padrões de pronúncia de terminações -ed em past tense regular (/t/, /d/, /ɪd/)
components.description_en: Recognize the three pronunciation patterns of regular past tense -ed endings (/t/, /d/, /ɪd/)
components.cc_component_description: Recognize common inflectional endings such as -s, -ed, and -ing added to a root word

components.description_pt: Classificar verbos em past tense regular de acordo com sua pronúncia de terminação -ed
components.description_en: Classify regular past tense verbs according to their -ed ending pronunciation

components.description_pt: Aplicar pronúncia correta de terminações -ed ao ler verbos em past tense regular em voz alta
components.description_en: Apply correct pronunciation of -ed endings when reading regular past tense verbs aloud

cc_matches.description: Identify frequently occurring root words (e.g., look) and their inflectional forms (e.g., looks, looked, looking).
